ai.title: Scan equipment and view exercise setup
ai.description: The recording shows the equipment scanner identifying a plate-loaded iso-lateral chest press machine, followed by its exercise details and a routine setup screen with set targets.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-3.1s: Coach tab is visible with the Scan equipment tool listed.
3.2-4.7s: Scan equipment screen shows an empty camera frame and instructions to frame the whole machine.
4.8-14.3s: A chest press machine appears in the scanner with a “Recognizing machine...” status.
14.4-19.1s: The identified machine’s details screen shows the exercise name, primary muscles, usage instructions, and Scan again and Add to workout buttons.
19.2-20.7s: A New routine screen shows the machine exercise listed.
20.8-35.1s: Set-targets screen displays three sets with rep and weight fields; visible weight values are edited, ending at 60 kg, 65 kg, and 70 kg, with 10 reps shown for each set.
35.2-36.7s: The New routine screen is shown with a Saving... status over the equipment details screen.
36.8-38.3s: The machine’s exercise details screen appears, followed by the Coach tab.

ai.title: Upper Body workout tracking and completion
ai.description: The recording shows a Train routine being opened, an Upper Body workout tracked set by set, and a workout-complete summary. It also shows the Train calendar and workout options.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-1.1s: Coach tab showing AI Coach and Scan food/Scan equipment tools.
1.1-5.3s: Train tab showing a calendar, an empty Today's plan, and workout plans including Upper Body.
5.3-8.5s: Upper Body routine detail listing Bench Press, Overhead Press, and Tricep Dips, with a Start workout button.
8.5-15.9s: Active Upper Body workout screen with exercise sets, weight and rep fields, checked set indicators, a timer, and a rest countdown.
15.9-17.0s: Workout-complete screen showing duration, total volume, sets done, and exercises.
17.0-19.1s: Coach plans list and Train calendar screens are visible.
19.1-21.2s: Add workout panel shows available routines, including Upper Body and other workout categories.
21.2-24.4s: Train calendar shows an Upper Body workout card with Preview and Start workout buttons.
privacy_concerns: A truncated name, “Aleks...”, is visible in the Train header.

ai.title: Scan a meal and review its nutrition
ai.description: A food photo is selected and analyzed in Scan food. The app displays a meal labeled “Kebabs with Omelette,” detected ingredients and nutrition values, then shows a nutrition breakdown and the meal in Nutrition diary.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-3.6s: AI Coach screen shows the Scan food tool, followed by its camera screen with a prompt to place food inside the frame.
5.4-7.2s: A Google Photos picker is open with food and other thumbnails; a food photo is selected.
7.2-10.7s: The selected food photo appears in the Scan food frame with an “Analyzing your plate...” message.
12.5-16.1s: Scan results show “Kebabs with Omelette,” 380 g, 612 kcal, and detected ingredients kebabs, omelette, and onions with weights.
16.1-19.7s: The result screen shows meal-type choices and Rescan and See breakdown buttons; Lunch is highlighted in a later frame.
19.7-25.1s: A nutrition breakdown shows 612 kcal, 46 g protein, 58 g carbs, and 19 g fat, with a Log to diary button.
25.1-28.7s: Nutrition diary displays its daily goal, meal plan, and logged “Kebabs with Omelette” meal.
28.7-34.1s: The diary view continues; a brief “Remove meal” control is visible beside the logged meal in one frame.

ai.title: AI Coach chat and personalized plans
ai.description: The recording shows the Coach landing screen, then an AI Coach conversation with workout-history summaries, recovery guidance, workout details, and a dated meal plan. The chat contains a visible personal name and detailed fitness and nutrition information.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-1.4s: Coach landing screen shows the AI Coach introduction and tiles for Scan food, Scan equipment, AI Trainer, Body scan, and Nutrition diary.
2.0-6.8s: AI Coach chat is open, showing a long text response with workout and nutrition details and suggested prompt buttons beneath it.
7.5-10.9s: The chat displays recovery guidance, including suggestions for a lighter workout or mobility session and a medical disclaimer.
11.6-13.6s: The chat shows detailed workout history and a user message asking how the previous session or day went; an assistant summary is visible.
14.3-16.2s: The chat shows a dated meal-plan card with lunch, dinner, and snack entries, alongside the ongoing conversation.
privacy_concerns: The name “Aleksandar” is visible in the chat.
Detailed workout history, nutrition information, and health-related readings are visible.

ai.title: Scan a protein shake and review its nutrition breakdown
ai.description: The recording shows the Scan food interface framing a protein shake, then displaying an editable meal entry with estimated ingredients and nutrition values, followed by a macro breakdown and a confirmation that the meal was added to the diary.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-0.6s: AI Coach screen with the Scan food and Scan equipment tools visible.
0.6-2.5s: Scan food camera interface with framing guides and instructions to place food inside the frame.
2.5-6.3s: A video of a protein shake appears within the scan frame with an “Analyzing your plate…” overlay; the account handle proteinhouse_uae is visible.
6.3-9.5s: Scan result form appears for “Protein Shake,” showing 450 g, 320 kcal, and detected ingredients including whey protein powder, milk, peanut butter, and ice.
9.5-12.0s: The result form shows a meal-type selection with Dinner highlighted, along with Rescan and See breakdown buttons; the next screen displays the nutrition breakdown.
12.0-15.1s: Nutrition breakdown shows 320 kcal, 35 g protein, 25 g carbs, and 8 g fat. A later screen shows a “Meal added to your diary” confirmation.
privacy_concerns: The embedded video displays the account handle proteinhouse_uae.

ai.title: AI Coach meal-plan conversation
ai.description: The recording shows the AI Coach tools, then a chat where a user asks what they can do instead. The coach displays meal-planning guidance and a dated plan with options to skip, review, or implement it; a later message confirms planned meals were added to Meal Diary.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-1.7s: AI Coach tools screen shows Scan food, Scan equipment, AI Trainer, and Body scan cards.
2.6-3.4s: AI Coach chat displays a long nutrition and meal-plan response beneath an activity-sharing notice.
4.3-7.7s: The chat input is used to compose “what can I do instead?”; the on-screen keyboard is visible while the text is entered.
8.6-12.0s: The submitted question appears in the chat and the coach response is shown, including nutrition guidance and a medical-advice disclaimer.
12.9-15.5s: A “Your plan is ready below” card appears with a date, workout and planned-meal counts, and Skip, Implement, and Review plan options.
16.3-18.9s: The plan card remains visible; the Implement option is shown, followed by a plan status indicating meals were added.
19.8-20.6s: The coach chat shows a confirmation that planned meals were added to Meal Diary.
privacy_concerns: The chat includes health and nutrition-related content, a plan date, and workout/planned-meal counts; no visible real name, email, phone number, or face.

ai.title: Scan equipment to identify a seated shoulder press machine

1.8-6.5s: A seated shoulder press machine appears in the camera frame with a “Recognizing machine...” indicator.
6.5-8.3s: An identified equipment card appears for “seated shoulder press machine,” with muscle tags and usage instructions.
8.3-9.5s: New routine screen shows the seated shoulder press machine listed under Exercises.
9.5-10.7s: New routine screen remains visible with the same exercise listed.
10.7-14.25s: The identified seated shoulder press machine information screen is shown again with Scan again and Add to workout controls.

ai.title: Browsing training plans and workout routines

It displays details for a 25-minute full-body routine and a plate-loaded chest press routine, including their exercise lists and Start workout buttons. No workout in progress is shown.

2.5-4.9s: The full-body routine’s exercise list is shown at different scroll positions; the Start workout button remains visible.
4.9-5.9s: Coach plans and custom routines list is visible again.
5.9-7.4s: Detail page for “plate-loaded chest press routine,” showing one exercise and a Start workout button.
7.4-10.8s: Coach plans and custom routines list appears at different scroll positions.
10.8-11.8s: Train dashboard with the full-body workout listed under Today’s plan.

ai.title: AI Coach creates a workout from a chat request
ai.description: The AI Coach chat shows a user asking for a shorter gym session, a detailed workout response, and a later workout-added confirmation with a plan card.
recorded_interactions: 0.0-1.9s: AI Coach chat shows a plan card, a meal-diary update, and suggested prompts.
1.9-2.9s: A request for a shorter gym session is visible in the message field with the keyboard open.
2.9-4.9s: The request appears as a sent chat message; a reviewing-plans indicator is shown.
4.9-8.7s: AI Coach displays a detailed workout plan with warm-up, supersets, and notes.
8.7-13.6s: The message field is used to type “yes implement this today”; the keyboard is visible.
13.6-16.5s: The typed message appears as a sent chat bubble, followed by a reviewing-plans indicator.
16.5-23.3s: The chat shows “Added 1 workout to Train” and a workout plan card.
privacy_concerns: A banner indicates activity sharing for “Today's readings” is enabled; the screen also contains a personal fitness request and workout-plan details.
